title: scorzoneroides autumnalis var. cinerascens
intro: Scorzoneroides autumnalis var. cinerascens, commonly known as autumn knapweed, is a perennial plant belonging to the sunflower family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the severity of wounds. The therapeutic actions of autumn knapweed include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Scorzoneroides autumnalis var. cinerascens include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
